messages:
Jordan: Quick leadership brief — three things to note today. TL;DR: new baseline data-retention rules, EU Private Beta goes live next week for a 5-customer pilot, and a small SLO tweak for Dedicated customers. Details below.
Priya: Thanks — can you drop links and owners?
Jordan: Link to internal doc below. Owners: Marco -> infra & region failover, Lin -> legal/compliance signoff, Aisha -> pilot onboarding & comms.
Marco: Infra quick status: capacity reservations in eu-west are green, need a config flip window Thu 03:00–04:00 UTC to enable routing and KV cache keys. If we get that window we can meet launch.
Aisha: Noted — I'll block pre-brief sessions with each pilot and draft the onboarding runbook.
Lin: On retention: proposal is 90 days for logs/metadata, 365 days for customer content by default unless customer specifies otherwise. Eval artifacts that contain PII must be redacted and will default to 90d.
Priya: For regulated customers in EU, do we default to 365 or make that opt-in?
Lin: We'll default to 365 for customer content but add a per-customer retention flag during provisioning. Legal to produce a short FAQ and compliance checklist.
Jordan: Quick ask: surface a short summary for the board on Friday — include expected Dedicated capacity utilization, estimated per-token cost delta from retention changes, and pilot NPS targets.
Priya: Draft KPIs I'll send in 30m: Dedicated utilization %, p95 latency, per-token cost delta, pilot NPS, and MTTR for failovers.
OpsBot: [auto] eu-private-beta-checklist created: https://internal.redwood/docs/eu-private-beta-checklist (internal)
Marco: I'll schedule the Thu freeze now and post the runbook for the flip. Ack. :calendar:
Aisha: Drafted onboarding email + runbook outline; will iterate with Marco for cutover steps. :rocket:
Lin: Compliance FAQ posted by EOD, will include retention options and the customer flag instructions. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Thanks. One operational note — for Dedicated SLOs we're tightening latency SLO on the critical path by 5% for new rollouts, but we are grandfathering existing contracts; ops will auto-fallback to a compatible model variant on sustained pressure.
Priya: Good call. We'll include a short migration playbook for teams.
Jordan: If anything blocks launch, ping me directly. Otherwise expect a brief public note to customers next Mon AM once pilots are confirmed. —J
